content:
With the highly anticipated launch of the all-new iPhone Duo and the latest iPhone 18 Pro, accessory maker dbrand has immediately announced its newest lineup of cases, skins, and screen protectors.

Whether you're looking for a minimalist case that's barely noticeable, or the ultimate no-compromise protection, dbrand has you covered.

MNML: $39

The name says it all. The MNML case is extremely thin, lightweight, and pocket-friendly, yet provides surprisingly solid protection. Installation is simple with a perfect fit.

The sandstone coating offers an attractive texture that feels comfortable and secure in hand. Despite its slim profile, the case can withstand drops of up to 10 feet. It features built-in magnets compatible with chargers, wallets, and car phone mounts.

Ghost: Original price $59.95, sale price $49.95

If you don't want a case to hide the beautiful look of your shiny new iPhone, the Ghost is your best bet. The common problem with most clear cases is that they yellow over time, completely ruining the unobstructed view of your iPhone. dbrand is so confident in the Ghost's anti-yellowing properties that they promise it will never yellow—for life. No fine print, no loopholes; if it yellows, they'll replace it for free.

It's made from a high-strength polymer, providing an invisible barrier for your phone against everyday scratches and wear. The texture is extremely grippy, the buttons are crisp, and it features the strongest magnet array of any dbrand case to date. Unlike other budget cases that cut out a hole for the camera control button, the Ghost features its own mechanical buttons with a built-in PCB circuit board, offering full touch functionality.

Grip: Starting from $54.90

As the name suggests, the Grip claims to be the world's most non-slip phone case. The surface of the case is covered with thousands of microscopic grip particles invisible to the naked eye.

Despite being only two millimeters thick, it meets military-grade drop protection standards. The raised camera bump is also protected, so you don't have to worry when you set it down on a table. If you've ever struggled to swipe from the edge of your screen because your case gets in the way, you'll love the Grip's lowered edge design.

Tank: Original price $59.95, sale price $49.95

If your average time from unboxing a new iPhone to dropping it is about 30 seconds, this case is made for you. The Tank case isn't just tactical in looks—it's also built to tactical standards. The combination of grooves and ridges ensures a secure grip, the raised bezel protects the screen during face-down drops, and the camera module is similarly protected if it lands on its back.

The Tank also offers a high degree of customization. The dots aren't just crisp and durable, they have a unique texture that you can identify by feel alone—and the custom accessory combinations are interchangeable.

Skin: Starting from $19.95

If you're the type of person who, upon hearing someone talk about dropping their phone, responds with "I'd never do that," then dbrand's skins are for you.

The ultra-thin design is precise to within a thousandth of a millimeter, fitting the device perfectly, adding to its appearance without adding any bulk. It still provides excellent scratch resistance and a premium textured feel. A variety of eye-catching designs are available to choose from.

Prism: $34.95—or $29.95 when purchased with any case

Remember how annoying screen protectors used to be? Difficult installation, constantly misaligned with the screen, trapped dust and bubbles, and ending up covered in fingerprints.

But the Prism is different. A precision installation tray ensures a perfect fit every time. The electrostatic peel layer removes dust during application, and the only bubbles you'll see will be in the drink you're pouring to celebrate a successful install.

Finally, a high-performance oleophobic coating ensures it never picks up fingerprints. Though invisible to the naked eye, it's made from premium tempered glass with a Mohs hardness rating of 7, offering top-tier scratch protection.

Head over to the dbrand website to check out the full range of cases, skins, and screen protectors.
